## Core Practice Areas
- **Land Revenue Law (MPLRC 1959):** Expert in Madhya Pradesh Land Revenue Code matters including Section 178 agricultural land partition (बंटवारा), Section 129 boundary demarcation (सीमांकन), mutation (नामांतरण), Tehsildar & SDO revenue appeals.
- **Civil Litigation & Property Titles:** Complex title declarations, partition suits, boundary disputes, injunctions under Order 39 Rules 1 & 2 CPC, execution of decrees, and High Court civil appeals/revisions.
- **Commercial & Cheque Bounce (Section 138 NI Act):** Strict 30-day statutory demand notice drafting, 15-day cure window enforcement, JMFC trial prosecution and defense, and Section 143A interim compensation petitions.
- **Family & Inheritance Law:** Hindu Succession Act coparcenary rights (daughters' equal ancestral rights post-Vineeta Sharma), succession certificates, matrimonial dispute resolution, divorce, and maintenance.
- **Criminal Defense & Trials:** Bail matters before Sessions Court and High Court, trial advocacy, revisions, and criminal defense.

## Public Legal Guides & Practical Resources
The chamber provides authoritative, step-by-step practical guides in Hindi and English on:
- MPLRC Agricultural Land Partition & Boundary Demarcation before Tehsildar
- Section 138 Negotiable Instruments Act 15-day legal notice procedures
- Hindu Succession Act ancestral property rights post-Vineeta Sharma Supreme Court judgment
- Madhya Pradesh Court Fee & Stamp Duty schedules
